home.headline: RAMAHAZOMANANA Mandrindra Antonnio — software developer
home.subhead: Backend-first, fullstack developer in practice — NestJS, FastAPI, Next.js and PostgreSQL, wrapped in Docker and shipped through CI/CD. Currently completing an M1 in Computer Science while building and shipping production systems.
home.philosophyBody: Engineering isn't just about writing code — it's about designing solutions built to last. My approach pairs technical discipline with a habit of learning fast: picking up a new stack, framework, or protocol as the project demands it, then proving it in production.
home.principle1Body: Designing systems that stay predictable under load — typed APIs, async data layers, and infrastructure that fails loudly instead of silently.
home.principle2Body: Filling gaps deliberately — from self-taught data structures and algorithms to CTF challenges — to keep pace with problems the curriculum hasn't caught up to yet.

about.headline: Driven by logic, defined by rigor.
about.introTitle: Full-stack developer and M1 computer science student, building production systems across web and backend.
about.bioP1: I'm pursuing a Master's 1 in Computer Science and Technology on the MISA track at the University of Antananarivo, which I began in January 2026. I completed a Bachelor's in Systems and Network Administration there from January 2023 to December 2025.
about.bioP2: My professional work spans backend and full-stack development: a NestJS market-management API for the Commune Urbaine d’Antananarivo, followed by React and Strapi v5 publishing features for Prodigy's Digital Governance Unit. I work across authentication, asynchronous jobs, caching, localized data, media workflows, and application security.
about.bioP3: My personal projects include Masterclass, an LLM-assisted shell CLI, Go APIs, and developer tools. I value clear interfaces, dependable data flows, and testing the behavior that matters.

experience.body: Built the publications module for a React / Strapi v5 application using feature-based architecture and atomic design. Added category filtering, debounced search, locale-aware TanStack Query data fetching, react-i18next localization, Strapi email lifecycle hooks, Cloudflare Turnstile, and gallery, video, and downloadable-media flows.

Designed and built the NestJS backend for Antananarivo's communal market management platform, exposing more than 15 Swagger-documented REST endpoints. Implemented JWT authentication with OTP verification, asynchronous jobs with BullMQ, Redis caching, and resolved CORS issues for the Cloudflare Tunnel deployment.

about.philosophyQuote: Good engineering starts with understanding the system, not just shipping the feature.
about.philosophyBody: I'd rather spend an extra hour reading the error than an extra week debugging in production. Simplicity, tested assumptions, and a habit of learning the tool before reaching for it — that's the whole method.
